controls.knowledge_source: variable names read by GPT-4o inside the pipeline; arms real / neutral / swapped per datasets/suite_q1s2/MAPPING.json

metric_defs.adj_f1: F1 over unordered adjacencies (any edge type)
metric_defs.dir_f1: F1 over directed edges, rule in orientation_rule
metric_defs.shd_cpdag: SHD against the true graph's CPDAG: one per unordered pair whose edge type differs

orientation_rule: only committed directions count; an undirected pair is no prediction; a two-way conflict predicts both (analysis/cc_graph.py score())
note: BND-08 live runs (label s2, 30 runs, one per arm, gpt-4o-2024-08-06). S3 (graph handed to the cycle step) is the primary endpoint; stability.py's T1 fails by design because the only run of 6 arms crashed in the cycle step; those runs are scored at S3 by partial_stages.py (gates Q1-Q3 pass).
